description.value: Krave Kulture is Vancouver's first craft yogurt shop, founded during the pandemic by Kamran and Moji, with a second location now open inside Lonsdale Quay Market. All yogurt is made fresh in-house daily using organic Canadian milk, with offerings spanning froyo bowls, smoothies, and probiotic-rich kefir. The shop is built around the health benefits of live bacterial cultures, homemade fruit jams, and minimal processing.

address.value: Unit 154, 123 Carrie Cates Court, North Vancouver, BC
